note: Round 6 exploration (Larus GL-2), probes through src/physics/gates/pool.js: nominal M1, M2 (60 s), M3, M5 and M4 seeds; corners as missions.mjs. Not gate files; the gate table is docs/status/round6-gates-larus.txt. Probe outputs in out/sweep/round6/ and out/sweep/round6/levers/.

rows.verdict: the delayed clamp lets the motor current reach 55 A against its 34 A setting; the crank stays within the 14.16 N m train rating at nominal (13.78)

rows.what: B with the fixed stroke at 41 deg

rows.what: the drive clamp in the ESC firmware (exempt from the 20 ms delay)
rows.verdict: not adopted: AM32 documents no Current Limit behaviour beyond its code and neither AM32 nor Holybro states whether the sensor reads battery or phase current, so it cannot be modelled exactly; its code averages the current over 50 samples at about 1 kHz and moves the duty cap at most 10/2000 per tick (0.5%/ms), slower than the FC path with 20 ms

rows.what: v15 (lever B at the round-5 step 1/960 s) flew M1-M8 with corners: M7 failed only its time-step rule, the left forward shoulder bushing's peak (its smallest load, about 184 N, FoS about 20) moving 13.7% at half the step; M1 failed at aero 0.9 mass 1.05 (both CG), M4 97/100 at those two corners
rows.fix: v16: the same design at 1/1920 s, where those seeds move 6% at half the step (ROUND6_OPT.dt; round 4's rule: the step at which the peaks converge)
